therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: beta-adrenergic receptor and alpha-1 adrenergic receptor
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: sympathetic nervous system inhibition and cardiac remodeling attenuation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Japanese patients with chronic heart failure
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants with adverse events by severity (safety and tolerability)

results.effect_size: SK&F-105517-D: 1 severe AE, 5 moderate AEs, 10 mild AEs; CRV-IR: 0 severe AEs, 2 moderate AEs, 9 mild AEs
results.target_engagement_evidence: Heart rate reduction of ~10.6 bpm (SK&F-105517-D) and ~10.4 bpm (CRV-IR) at Week 8; S-carvedilol AUC0-24 higher with SK&F-105517-D (155.1 vs 60.0 h*ng/mL); Tmax delayed with SK&F-105517-D (~6 h vs ~2 h for CRV-IR)
biomarker_changes: BNP decreased from 226.46 to 111.93 ng/L (SK&F-105517-D) and from 108.93 to 64.88 ng/L (CRV-IR) at Week 8
LVEF increased from 32.2% to 37.6% (SK&F-105517-D) and from 34.0% to 42.0% (CRV-IR) at Week 8
Cardiothoracic ratio decreased from 53.58% to 52.35% (SK&F-105517-D) and from 53.70% to 50.91% (CRV-IR) at Week 8
Heart rate change from baseline: SK&F-105517-D -10.6 bpm, CRV-IR -10.4 bpm
Systolic BP change from baseline: SK&F-105517-D +10.0 mmHg, CRV-IR -5.7 mmHg
S-carvedilol Cmax higher with SK&F-105517-D (12.82 ng/mL) vs CRV-IR (6.80 ng/mL)
R-carvedilol Cmax higher with SK&F-105517-D (27.13 ng/mL) vs CRV-IR (19.19 ng/mL)
SB-203231 (M4 metabolite) Cmax higher with SK&F-105517-D (6.39 ng/mL) vs CRV-IR (3.17 ng/mL)
subgroup_findings: NYHA functional class: 1 patient improved with SK&F-105517-D vs 0 with CRV-IR; 7 unchanged (SK&F-105517-D) vs 11 unchanged (CRV-IR)
Sleeping systolic BP difference (SK&F-105517-D vs CRV-IR): mean difference +25.04 mmHg (95% CI: 13.16–36.93)
Sleeping diastolic BP difference: mean difference +18.06 mmHg (95% CI: 13.36–22.76)
safety_signals: 1 serious AE of bradycardia in SK&F-105517-D group
1 serious AE of cardiac failure in CRV-IR group
1 serious AE of oedema in SK&F-105517-D group
1 serious AE of bronchitis in SK&F-105517-D group
Drug-related AEs: SK&F-105517-D: 1 severe, 3 moderate, 4 mild; CRV-IR: 0 severe, 2 moderate, 3 mild

dose_info.dose: SK&F-105517-D: 10 mg, 20 mg, or 40 mg once daily; CRV-IR: 2.5 mg or 10 mg twice daily
dose_info.schedule: SK&F-105517-D: once daily; CRV-IR: twice daily

context.duration: 8 weeks (CRV-IR) or 14 weeks (SK&F-105517-D) treatment plus 1-week follow-up
